Title: Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now ISO 27001 certified

Body.Content:
The ISO/IEC 27000 family of standards helps organizations of every type and size keep their information assets secure.

This is in addition to existing certifications such as  SOC 1,2,3,  FedRAMP,  HITRUST, and  PCI DSS. See the  full certification status of Azure Red Hat OpenShift along with all other Azure services.

Learn more.
